decisions.reason: The source changes the hero visual asset and supporting media layout but does not change the established hero headline or explanatory copy.

The hero-specific instruction refines an independently represented visual asset and remains compatible with the landing page's general inclusion of images; it does not necessarily change the broader page architecture state.
Specifying an AI-generated hero layout image, link buttons, and supporting images does not alter the site's clean, minimal SaaS style, style reference, or brand-colour source.
The hero media instruction does not change the Webflow platform, hosting configuration, or selected site plan.
